say: Stranger. You carry meat. Raw. Beast? Not kin?
Hungry hands, but you carry meat. Raw meat. Is it beast, stranger? Say beast.
Hush smells blood on your pack. Beast blood? Say true.
Beast. Take it. Three pieces.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Beast. Yes. Hush takes. Hush remembers who feeds the gate.
Good meat. Clean. The gate opens a little for you.
...Thank. Not many say thank, here.
Not today.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Then walk. The gate waits. Hunger does not.
Hush will be here. Hush is always here.
Empty hands. The Plains eat those who walk empty. Bring meat. Raw. Beast. Then the gate opens.
Hush keeps the gate. Past the gate, kin who eat people. Here, no. Bring meat, beast meat, and Hush listens.
You want pass? Meat first. Raw. Not kin, not people. Hush counts.
Gate is small. Hunger is big. Bring meat. Hush wants no more hungry kin at the gate.
More meat? Hush does not forget the last. Beast?
You return. You carry meat. Hush is glad.
The gate remembers you. Meat again?
Beast. Take it.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Hush takes. Mouths here thank you.
Good. The gate opens more.
Yes. Beast. Clean. You are friend of the gate, nearly.
Not now.
then.speaker: T_TARGET_IF_PLAYER

say: Hush waits.
You are not kin, not food. Hush does not know word for you.
Past the gate the Plains are loud with hunger. Here is small peace.
Hush does not say her old name. The old name ate people. The new name is quiet.
Walk slow near gate. Little ones watch. Little ones remember fast.
Friend of the gate. Hush says it slow so it stays true.
Gate is yours. Walk past; Hush's hunters will not follow. Kin beyond will. Kin are not Hush's to stop.
Once Hush held the Chief's knife. Hush left when the little ones asked for no more bones.
Meat Lord eats with a fork. Salt Mother cures with patience. The Cook talks sweet. Hush stops them at the gate, when she can.
Stop. Gate. Meat first, then talk.
Gate keep. You pass if you bring meat. Raw. Not kin.
Quiet, stranger. Little ones sleep. Hush decides.
You smell of road. Bring meat to Hush and walk.
Friend. Gate open. Walk safe.
Meat-bringer. Hush says you pass. Pass.
Good to see. Little ones remember you.
Careful past the gate. Kin are hungry.
Friend. Gate open.
You bring beast, you are family.
Hush speaks good of you.
